frontmatter.name: design
frontmatter.description: Choose the technology and design the system with the user, record the decisions, define the foundation and the gate, and suggest skills. Only when the user asks to design, choose a stack or architect the project.

frontmatter.name: add
frontmatter.description: Add an idea or task to the software factory backlog Inbox. Use when the user wants to queue work for the factory.

frontmatter.name: approve
frontmatter.description: Land a software factory task that is awaiting approval. Only when the user explicitly asks to approve a specific task.

frontmatter.name: discard
frontmatter.description: Delete a software factory task's work and return it to Ready. Only when the user explicitly asks to discard a specific task.

frontmatter.name: doctor
frontmatter.description: Check that the software factory is installed and this project is set up correctly. Use when the factory misbehaves or the user asks to check or diagnose the setup.

frontmatter.name: init
frontmatter.description: Set this project up for the software factory. Use when the user asks to initialize, install or set up the software factory in a project.

frontmatter.name: open
frontmatter.description: Start the software factory's control-plane GUI and give the link. Use when the user wants to see or open the factory GUI or dashboard.

frontmatter.name: run
frontmatter.description: Run software factory backlog items through triage, spec, build, check and review. Only when the user explicitly asks to run the factory.

frontmatter.name: status
frontmatter.description: Show what the software factory is doing: items that are ready, running, awaiting approval or blocked. Use when the user asks about factory progress or state.

frontmatter.name: planner
frontmatter.description: Turns the brief into requirements, milestones and tasks, and triages ad-hoc backlog items.

frontmatter.name: brainstorm
frontmatter.description: Work out with the user what they want to build, in plain language, and write the product brief. Only when the user asks to brainstorm, describe an idea or start a project.

frontmatter.name: plan
frontmatter.description: Turn the product brief into requirements, milestones and a task list for the factory's backlog, with the user's approval at each step. Only when the user asks to plan the work or break a project into tasks.

frontmatter.name: research
frontmatter.description: Research products similar to what the user wants to build, share what was found, and record it after the user approves. Only when the user asks to research competitors or similar products.

frontmatter.name: scribe
frontmatter.description: Keeps the documents, chronicle and context files current.

frontmatter.name: docs
frontmatter.description: Bring the README, user documentation and context files (AGENTS.md) up to date with what has been built, with the user's approval. Only when the user asks to update the documentation.

frontmatter.name: security-performance
frontmatter.description: Keeps the code safe and fast through four gates.

frontmatter.name: secure
frontmatter.description: Work out the threats, data protection and performance risks of the project with the user, or audit it before a release. Only when the user asks about security, privacy, performance or a release audit.

frontmatter.name: test
frontmatter.description: Check the product against its user stories and for accessibility, find what is not proven, and propose tasks to close the gaps. Only when the user asks to test, verify or check quality.

frontmatter.name: deploy
frontmatter.description: Put a tagged release in front of real users, one approved step at a time, then smoke-test it and roll back if it fails. Only when the user explicitly asks to deploy now.

frontmatter.name: release
frontmatter.description: Prepare the project to ship: interview the user about deployment, recommend hosting, write the deployment plan and runbooks, and when asked choose a version, write the changelog and tag it. Never deploys. Only when the user asks to release, prepare to deploy, or version the project.

frontmatter.name: ask
frontmatter.description: Talk to one of the software factory's roles, or run one of the team's conversations, by role name or responsibility id, including responsibilities the user added. Only when the user asks to consult a role.

frontmatter.name: team
frontmatter.description: Choose and shape the software factory team for this project: pick a preset, ask for a number of agents, move, merge, rename or switch off responsibilities, or add your own. Only when the user asks to change or look at the team.

frontmatter.name: git
frontmatter.description: Set up git and GitHub for this project (a private repository, the remote, .gitignore), or see what is waiting to be pushed or merged. Only when the user asks to set up version control, GitHub, pushing or pull requests.
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Bash(factory role:*) Bash(factory vcs) Bash(factory add:*) Bash(git status:*) Bash(git remote:*) Bash(git log:*) Bash(gh auth status)
